newsitem.title: UK: U.S. Treasuries in London closed for U.S. holiday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries in London closed for U.S. holiday.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries in London were closed on Monday with the U.S. market closed for the President's Day holiday.
On Friday, the 30-year T-bond closed at 101-08 to yield 6.53 percent in New York, up 17/32 on the day. At the short end two-year T-notes closed at 100-06, to yield 5.77 percent, up 2/32.
During the week U.S. January consumer price data and real earnings on Wednesday and the Philadelphia Fed Survey for February on Friday, will provide a focus for the market.
